name: Nattawin Wattanagitiphat
bio: Apo Nattawin Wattanagitiphat is a model and actor affiliated with Channel 3 from 2014 to 2019. He went to Thammasat University before transferring to the Faculty of Communication Arts at Rangsit University. In 2014, Nattawin signed a contract as an actor with Channel 3 and made his debut in Sud Kaen Saen Rak. In 2018, his last lakorn with Channel 3 was Chart Suer Pun Mungkorn. Nattawin went on hiatus for more than 2 years after his contract expired in 2019. In 2021, Nattawin returned as a freelance actor in the Thai series, KinnPorsche.
place: Hua Hin, Prachuap Khiri Khan, Thailand
